reported.title: Incorrect averaging scale
reported.description: The averageMm function scales the total incorrectly; it should scale by 1000 instead of 5000 to match the 1 mV/mm scaling.

reported.title: Lamp state timing issue
reported.description: The lamp state is updated immediately after taking a sample, which could lead to rapid toggling if the average level fluctuates around the threshold. This should be managed more smoothly.

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A3 scaled at 1 mV per mm; high-level lamp on D5.
- Take one sample every 30 ms and average the last 32 into a level in millimetres. Fill the window at power-up so the first printed level is already valid.
- Print `bin <mm> mm` every 1000 ms; the printed level must stay within ±40 mm of the injected level.
- Drive D5 HIGH when the averaged level is at or above 4300 mm; otherwise LOW, within 1500 ms.
- The probe reads up to 4800 mm.
